requirements.text: Each record is one JSON line with time, level and message, filtered by a configured level
Secret-bearing keys (passwords, tokens, authorization, cookies, API keys) are redacted at any depth, including headers and maps
Personal data inside free-text values (emails, card numbers) can be masked before it is written
Caller fields cannot overwrite reserved keys such as time, level or msg
Records carry a request ID, reusing a well-formed incoming x-request-id or generating one
Errors serialize with message, cause chain and optional stack, bounded in depth
Logging is cycle-safe, size-bounded and never throws into the caller, even when the sink fails

evidence.name: writes one JSON line per record with time, level, msg first and filters by level
redacts default and configured keys case-insensitively at any depth
reserved keys cannot be overwritten by fields
withRequest generates an ID when missing, malformed, or untrusted
serializes errors with bounded cause chains and optional stacks
is cycle-safe and bounds depth, arrays, keys, strings, and line size

implementations.notes: Redaction is key-based; it does not scan string values

evidence.name: PII masking and redaction match the shared vectors

implementations.notes: Masks emails, phones and Luhn-valid cards in text; calling it before logging is the app's wiring
